unresolved_findings.finding: No Atlas-paper relationship is asserted for this supporting Parareal software resource.

Tests use unseeded random problem generation, and the Dedalus integration includes an explicitly skipped MPI/deepcopy test.
The source is imported through path manipulation rather than a packaged installation interface.
Runtime behavior, tests, Dedalus compatibility and figure outputs remain unvalidated within the static-only boundary.
